question: Which memory-wiki isolation contract should OpenClaw support for shared-gateway multi-agent setups?
rationale: The fix changes config/API surface and durable memory isolation semantics, so automation should not pick a default sharing or isolation model without maintainer intent.

options.title: Plugin-owned isolated vault routing
options.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent/per-context vault mode or resolver with explicit fallback behavior and upgrade documentation.

options.title: Generic per-agent plugin overrides
options.body: Make `agents.list[].plugins` or an equivalent core config merge contract the canonical solution and adapt memory-wiki to it.

options.title: Document unsupported shared-gateway isolation
options.body: Close the feature gap by declaring memory-wiki shared vaults unsupported for multi-agent isolation until a broader plugin-config design lands.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned isolated vault routing
recommendation.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent/per-context vault mode or resolver with explicit fallback behavior and upgrade documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin config, agent config, and security posture, and this owner has the strongest recent cross-surface history among the likely owners.
